description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional categories in a dataset used for evaluating speaker anonymization on emotional speech, with six distinct emotion labels represented by colored segments. The largest segment, labeled “Frustration,” accounts for 25.1% and is shown in teal. The “Neutral” category follows closely at 23.1%, depicted in purple. “Happiness” occupies 8.1% and is colored light blue. “Excitement” makes up 14.1% and is shown in red. “Sadness” is represented by a brown segment at 14.7%, and “Anger” accounts for 14.9%, shown in yellow-green. Each slice is labeled with its emotion name and percentage value, and the chart uses a simple, flat design without 3D effects or exploded segments, allowing for clear visual comparison of the relative proportions of each emotional category in the dataset.
